test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the part that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.

And so for the sakes / of his son he remained, / absolutely calm.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct answer is 4)** "And so for the sakes"**.
 
• The **error in this segment **is the use of "sakes" instead of "sake".
 
• **"Sake"** is a noun used to refer to the purpose of, or in the interest of, something or someone.
 
• It is **generally used** in singular form.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** should be:* "And so for the sake of his son, he remained absolutely calm."*
